products.name: Membership — Individual
products.short_description: $499/month (or $5,988/year). For consultants and individual admins — full access to every published Phoenixtekk solution, with new releases every month.
products.description:
The whole library, for one monthly price

Stop buying solutions one project at a time. The Individual membership gives a consultant or solo administrator access to every published Phoenixtekk solution — guides and PowerShell scripts included — plus every update and every new release while you're a member.

What's included

  • Access to all published solutions in the catalog
  • Download every implementation guide (Word + PDF)
  • Download every PowerShell script pack
  • Solution updates — your library stays current automatically
  • Monthly new releases as the catalog grows

Why a membership?

One predictable price instead of paying per solution or per consulting day. Everything is self-guided and tested, so you implement at your own pace and keep what you download.

Pricing

$499 per month, or $5,988 per year. Cancel anytime.

  • DevOps work item templates and assessment frameworks

Why a membership?

Equip your whole team with a tested, repeatable delivery kit for one predictable price — far less than building it yourself or paying per-day consulting rates, and yours to reuse on every engagement.

Pricing

$999 per month, or $11,988 per year. Cancel anytime.

products.description:
Govern endpoint management at enterprise scale

The Enterprise membership adds organization-wide licensing, multi-admin access, internal training rights, and governance to everything in Professional — for organizations standardizing endpoint management across many administrators and sites.

What's included

  • Everything in Professional
  • Enterprise licensing — organization-wide rights
  • Multiple administrators
  • Internal training rights
  • Enterprise governance packages and architecture templates
  • Priority updates and Call Now / Fix Doc Now support

Why a membership?

A single governed program that standardizes how your whole organization deploys Microsoft endpoint solutions — tested, documented, and owned by your team — for a fraction of enterprise consulting retainers.

Pricing

$1,499 per month, or $17,988 per year. Cancel anytime.
